project_type: Monorepo: Next.js 14 web app + custom ECS game engine + Supabase backend
build_system: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo. 300-line file limit enforced. ECS pattern: Components = pure data, Systems = logic, ops = pure functions.
test_framework: Vitest (unit tests in __tests__/ directories colocated with source). Playwright for e2e. Tests are comprehensive - 885+ tests passing.
verification_instructions: 1) pnpm format:check 2) pnpm lint 3) pnpm build 4) pnpm test
environment_constraints: Node 22.23.1 via nvm. No Docker daemon available for db:verify. No hosted Supabase credentials needed - game boots in single-player sandbox mode. Prettier printWidth: 88.
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits. 12 locales (en, ko, ja, zh, es, fr, de, pt, ar, hi, th, vi). Files under 300 lines. ECS pattern with pure ops functions. i18n keys for all user-visible strings (decision D8). No violence/gambling/mature content (ages 10-18).
key_patterns: Components: pure data with type string (e.g., 'housing'). Systems: extend System class with requiredComponents array. Ops: pure functions in domain dirs (e.g., cooking/cookingOps.ts). Items: defined in packages/shared/src/items.ts as ItemId union + ITEM_DEFINITIONS record. Prices: packages/shared/src/economy.ts. i18n: flat dot-namespaced keys in apps/web/src/i18n/messages/*.ts. Stores: Zustand in apps/web/src/stores/. SQL migrations: sequential 00N_name.sql in packages/database/supabase/migrations/. Achievements: condition-based tagged union in achievementDefinitions.ts. Tests: use Harness pattern with entity + components + system.
directory_structure: apps/web/ = Next.js client (components/, game/, stores/, i18n/). packages/game-engine/src/ = ECS engine (ecs/, components/, systems/, plus domain dirs like cooking/, fishing/, quiz/ each with definitions + ops + index.ts). packages/shared/src/ = items, economy, constants. packages/database/supabase/migrations/ = SQL migrations (001-006).
